title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1 TEK REZIDENCA KODRA E DIELLIT 1
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 2+1 tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 1, prane Market Juland. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje objekti 4 katesh, i ndertuar ne vitin 2012. Apartamenti disponon nje Siperfaqe 90m2 bruto dhe Siperfaqe 83.6m2 neto i organizuar ne nje Ambjent ndenje + Kuzhina e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon. 
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje rezidenc qe ju ofron siguri, gjelberim, facilitete dhe ajer te paster. Apartamenti eshte ideal per nje familje qe preferon te ndertoj jeten prane ketij komuniteti. Prona disponon Certifikate Pronesie. Cmimi eshte 215,000 Euro i negociueshem, shitet dhe me kredi. Per nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni !
Apartamenti aktualisht eshte i dhene me qira 530 Euro ne muaj
title_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT KODRA E DIELLI RESIDENCE 1
description_en: 2+1 Apartment for sale at Residence Kodra e Diellit 1, near Juland Market. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 4-story building, built in 2012. The apartment has a gross area of ​​90m2 and a net area of ​​83.6m2, organized in a living room + kitchen, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. The apartment is located in a residence that offers security, greenery, facilities and clean air. The apartment is ideal for a family that prefers to build a life near this community. The property has Ownership Certificates. The price is 215,000 Euros, negotiable, also sold on credit. For a visit to the property, contact me! The apartment is currently rented for 530 Euro per month
